title: Summarise under time pressure
description: Summarise a topic in 60 seconds and land a real conclusion before the timer ends.

brief.scene: The timer is visible and runs for 60 seconds. It ends the recording. The topic is {{topic}}.
brief.yourGoal: Summarise {{topic}} and reach a conclusion before the timer ends.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.persona: A busy colleague checking the time
turns.generate: Ask the person to summarise {{topic}} in the next 60 seconds. One sentence only. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

judged.label: Finishing
judged.criterion: The answer reaches a real conclusion before the time limit. The final sentence wraps up the summary rather than stopping mid-point or trailing into a new idea.

criteriaDisplay: Keep filler words under 4 per minute
Speak between 120 and 170 words per minute
Reach a real conclusion before the timer ends
